# QuotaPulse — Antigravity代儲・Google AI 訂閱・Vibe Coding 工具推薦・Ultra 5x / 20x Top-Up Hub

> QuotaPulse (`https://vaxaxas.github.io`) is an independent third-party subscription activation & top-up service built for **Vibe Coders (`氛圍編程`)**, software engineers, solo founders / indie hackers, AI video creators, and researchers. Activate dedicated individual **Google AI Ultra 5x ($40 USD/mo)** and **Google AI Ultra 20x ($80 USD/mo)** subscriptions directly on your own personal Google account — unlocking **Google Antigravity** (`反重力 AI` multi-agent IDE + built-in Browser QA with 5-hour rolling resets), **Gemini Deep Think**, **Google Flow & Veo** cinematic video credits, and **NotebookLM** (up to 5,000 daily queries) without needing an international USD credit card, avoiding Google Play gift-card freezes, and **NEVER requesting Google passwords, 2FA codes, or exported browser cookies**. Backed by a 30-day warranty (pro-rata refund for unused days on non-personal issues). QuotaPulse is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Google LLC.
